description: Seal a message in a digital time capsule — it stays locked with a live countdown until its opening date arrives.

faqs.a: In this browser's localStorage, sealed until the opening date. They don't sync to other devices.
On or after the opening date the capsule unlocks and the message is revealed automatically.
faqs.q: What happens when the date arrives?

faqs.a: Deleting a sealed capsule is permanent — the message is gone. Only delete if you're sure.
faqs.q: Can I delete a sealed capsule?

howto: Write your message to the future.
Pick the date the capsule should open.
Press Seal capsule — a live countdown starts.
Come back on the date to read your message.
title: Time Capsule Maker
